label: Government
title: Public & Civic
body: Where collective output becomes public infrastructure. Government has a fundamentally different procurement process, budget authority, and decision timeline. DTS is SAM.gov qualified. Organized by function — not agency level.

cards.title: Infrastructure & Cities
cards.text: Municipal twins, transportation, utility grids, urban planning.

cards.title: Coastal Resilience
cards.text: Parish-scale digital twins, GIS, and scenario planning for coastal risk.

cards.title: Regulatory & Compliance
cards.text: Food safety, environmental compliance, inspection training.

cards.title: Civic Services
cards.text: Libraries, transit, parks, civic engagement, accessibility.

cards.title: Safety & Emergency
cards.text: GOHSEP, FEMA PA documentation, disaster response twins.
